name: RC-B10-0101/2025 – After § 2 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text: 2a. Considers that it is not consistent to criticise Nigeria’s blasphemy laws while simultaneously supporting ‘hate speech’ laws that are, in fact, a secular equivalent to blasphemy laws;
